author: Bhuvanesh Verma
title: TTLab Paper Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026 Daleel Shared Task
description: We are happy to announce that our paper 'STAR-Ar: Sequence Tagging for Argument Recognition in Arabic' by Bhuvanesh Verma, Ali Abusaleh, and Alexander Mehler has been accepted at the SIGARAB ArabicNLP 2026 Daleel Shared Task. The paper presents a sequence-tagging approach to argument component identification and classification in Arabic text.

author: Ali Abusaleh
title: TTLab Paper Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026 AlexandriaX Shared Task
description: We are happy to announce that our paper 'A Fine-Tuned Surface Tagger for Arabic Machine-Translation Error-Span Detection and Classification' by Ali Abusaleh, Bhuvanesh Verma, and Alexander Mehler has been accepted at the SIGARAB ArabicNLP 2026 AlexandriaX Shared Task. The work addresses error-span detection and classification for dialectal Arabic machine translation.

author: Bhuvanesh Verma
title: TTLab Paper Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026 StanceEval Shared Task
description: We are happy to announce that our paper 'CLASP-Ar: A Cloze-Style Prompting Approach for Arabic-Language Stance Detection' by Bhuvanesh Verma, Ali Abusaleh, and Alexander Mehler has been accepted at the SIGARAB ArabicNLP 2026 StanceEval Shared Task. The paper introduces a cloze-style prompting method for Arabic stance detection.

author: Coco Sittardt
title: ENTAILab Anonymization Website available
description: The browser-based anonymization application developed by Coco Sittardt is now available at anonymization.entailab.texttechnologylab.org.

author: Mevlüt Bagci
title: ENTAILab GitHub Pages documentation updated
description: The public documentation has received a major frontend update with a revised structure, dedicated content sections, a news area, and data-driven project information.

author: Mevlüt Bagci
title: New KONVENS 2026 paper
description: The paper Extending a Parliamentary Corpus with MPs’ Tweets: Automatic Annotation and Evaluation Using TTLABTWEETCORPUS has been accepted for KONVENS 2026.
